fact: ONECI director-general Ago Christian Kodia said a parent's national identity card now supplies the identity information directly on the new birth-registration terminal.

AIP reports that the civil-registry digitisation reform is piloted by ONECI, the national office for civil status and identification, with all civil registration centres equipped with Citiweb software at end 2025.

ONECI, the national civil-status and identification office, is training 44 civil-registry agents in the Goh region from 27 July 2026 on its Citiweb software for capturing births, marriages and deaths.

ONECI, the Office national de l'etat civil et de l'identification, runs both civil status and identification, and its director general said on 16 September 2025 that its digital civil-status server is linked to the Registre national des personnes physiques.

ONECI deputy director general Pélagie Gonto said in October 2024 that the national identification number (NNI) is now placed on civil status certificates, and that the number follows each person through civil registration.

ONECI's slides for ID4Africa 2026 set out an integrated CRVS-ID path in which a registered birth leads to a unique identifier and later life events, including death, update the same identity, and list supporting the digital transformation of civil registration to feed identity as an aim.
